title: The Phantom Swap

captures.note: real swap: 0.0005 ETH → USDC via DexRouter
dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Phantom's built-in Swap, ETH→USDC. The swap tab opens on Solana (SOL→USDC) over a trending-memecoin list. Opening it POSTs every address from your seed across chains (swap/v2/initialize). Quotes stream from Phantom's server; the quote screen showed a 0.85% Phantom fee and Auto slippage 4.9% for ETH→USDC. The tx went to router 0x8feab81d…b4f6 (Sourcify name DexRouter). The signed swap did NOT go through Phantom's RPC: it was POSTed to Phantom's submission service. No address screening and no recents upload on this flow. Real mainnet tx 0xf51e4db3af41122c437fd35d18112b317eeadd4a735666e28df46a7f54383bb9.
